images.after: Step 1: Collect the phrases people really type
images.title: Four free places to find phrases
images.alt: Four free sources of real search wording: Google autocomplete, People Also Ask, related searches, and forum or Reddit thread titles.
images.caption: Put everything in a spreadsheet and don't filter yet.

items.title: Google autocomplete
items.text: Type the seed, then add a letter or a question word. Use a private window.

items.title: People Also Ask
items.text: Expand the question boxes. Each one you open loads more.

items.title: Related searches
items.text: The bottom of the results page shows neighbouring angles on the topic.

items.title: Forums and Reddit
items.text: Thread titles show problems in people's own words.

images.after: What search volume numbers can and can't tell you
images.title: What search volume tells you
images.alt: Comparison of what search volume numbers are good for, such as rough comparisons, against what they can't tell you, such as exact traffic.
images.caption: Use volume to compare queries roughly, more versus less, and don't plan around the exact figure.

columns.label: It can tell you
points: A phrase in autocomplete is likely searched
That a made-up phrase may have no searches

columns.label: It can't tell you
points: An exact figure; every one is an estimate
A minimum worth writing about; there isn't one

images.title: From broad topic to one query
images.alt: Worked example narrowing indoor herb garden through autocomplete, People Also Ask and forums to the query why is my basil dying under a grow light.
images.caption: The result answers one question for one type of reader, which a new site can realistically compete for.
images.note: Example phrases only; volume and rankings weren't measured.

items.label: Seed: indoor herb garden
items.text: Too broad for a new site; retailers and big publishers rank.

items.label: Forums
items.text: Repeated threads about basil wilting under a grow light.

items.label: Candidate query
items.text: "why is my basil dying under a grow light" (informational).

items.label: Results check
items.text: Mostly forums and passing mentions is a gap. Full articles: try again.
